shape: 2-portal sprawling arena (N + S gates) with NW + SE clusters bridged at the center
description: Two-portal arena. NW CLUSTER (south entry hub 2qfqhd at (-8.85, 17.10), 5-way) joins spawn_south plus west wall anchors (vd8uwc + 8aqjkc + 64zesk) plus center (6u31mr). WEST WALL CHAIN: 9rlwns → nbaz7p (SW corner) + xqfufg (SW pocket). SE CLUSTER (34d4za at (6.71, 7.44), 4-way) joins center + east anchors (ja69y0 + jwvkwv + gsz5r8). NORTH ENTRY area: 2jyczi (4-way) + jg1g7t (4-way) form a small clique near spawn_north.

portals.north: spawn_north at (7.60, -23.12) — gate on the north (low-Z) side
portals.south: spawn_south at (-9.05, 23.34) — gate on the south (high-Z) side

traversalNotes: Direct N→S: spawn_north → north_inner → north_c → e_mid (or se_corner via the east clique) → ... no direct center bridge.
DISPATCH RULE: south_inner (5-way) handles south cluster + west wall; se_hub (4-way) handles east upper/mid; north_c (4-way) handles east-side from north.
BRIDGE: center_n (6u31mr) is the only bridge between the south_inner clique and the se_hub clique. Strict — without it, the south and north halves are disconnected.
Pockets: sw_pocket, sw_corner off w_mid; nothing to the west of w_mid is reachable without going through south_inner.
